## Hello, I'm Annamalai Vikash Raam Manoj.

I'm a Computer Science graduate currently pursuing a Master's in Business Analytics at Monash University.

I'm interested in how data can be used to understand problems, uncover useful insights, and communicate findings clearly. Through this website, I'll share my work in data analysis, visualisation, and communicating evidence.
